recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If SupplyRequest returns to core, preserve DeviceDefinition as an allowed SupplyRequest.item target; otherwise make future active SupplyRequest.item changes in HL7/oo-incubator.
issue_request: FHIR-20941 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request, applied for R5, asking to add DeviceDefinition to SupplyRequest.itemReference because supply requests commonly identify kinds of devices rather than specific device instances.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-20941 was found. The same change family was later refined by FHIR-26301 and implemented by 0603ec82cd, which changed the pre-R5 SupplyRequest spreadsheet to CodeableReference(Medication|Substance|Device|DeviceDefinition). Commit 33b409a4b6 preserved DeviceDefinition in the XML StructureDefinition and is contained in v5.0.0.
additional_context: FHIR-26301 already has an external-repo reconciliation commit on the combined branch. Neighboring FHIR-20942 was a same-block-vote proposal to remove Substance from the same choice, but it was retracted and does not conflict. Commit 3b38b80cf2 removed SupplyRequest from active core fhir.ini resource registration and pointed core links to the OO Incubator additional-resources IG; the active OO Incubator artifact still includes DeviceDefinition.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The requested capability is present in retained source and in the active external OO Incubator artifact, while current core no longer publishes SupplyRequest as an active resource.

related_jiras.note: Later Published R5 issue refined the same DeviceDefinition request to CodeableReference and was implemented by the source commit that added DeviceDefinition.
Same block vote and same choice element, but the proposal to remove Substance was retracted and does not alter the DeviceDefinition conclusion.
